notes.title: NEW UPDATE - December 19
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Silky Smooth Studios has a new update for Witchcraft. We focused on fixing things, making better controllers and also adding more content.

The three changes are listed below:
[list]
 	[*]Fixed a bug where you couldn't pick custom skills with joystick arrows.[/*]
 	[*]The following skills no longer impact with a wall when casting if you are next to it:
[list]
 	[*]Arctic Strike[/*]
 	[*]Crystal Saw[/*]
 	[*]Igneous Cloud[/*]
 	[*]Mjolnir's Call[/*]
 	[*]Phoenix Assault[/*]
 	[*]Sonic Blast[/*]
 	[*]Voltaic Link[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]The keyboard controls have been changed. Now the player will move with WASD, aim with mouse and fire with Q, E, Left click and Right click. These controls are subject to modifications but as soon as we have something defined we will work on the control's interface.[/*]
 	[*]We are adding with this update chromes and badges for the Steam version. They will need to be approved by Steam first, but we hope they will start showing up soon.[/*]
[/list]
So that's everything for now. Please let us know if you have any suggestion or if you find something wrong.

Best regards,

Facundo

Lead Programmer of Silky Smooth Studios.
